question: What process unfolds once the attainment of melāpa has been reached?
premises: The attainment of melāpa is resorted to
Devouring of time is the operative process
This devouring is extended or unfolded
inference: Resorting to the attainment of melāpa brings about the extension of time-devouring
plain_english: Having attained the union, the devouring of time is indeed extended.
